claim: Historical forecasting results are end-to-end detector-to-warning results.
The new R13 experiment may evaluate detector -> tracker -> forecasting -> warning propagation.
ByteTrack is the frozen primary tracker.
BoT-SORT is a frozen sensitivity tracker.
Tracker parameters may be tuned after viewing TestReal results.
Interpolated trajectory points are used as primary tracking GT.
Tracking metrics must include HOTA, IDF1, ID-switches, and fragmentation.
